changelog_html:
1.7.0

  • Price Book. Administrators edit every product, price, and price break under Settings → Cost Calculator. One row per product: name, seasonal note, retail and three bulk rates, slices per pound, with yield and default fresh cost in columns hidden by default so a routine price update cannot change them. Rows can be added, hidden, and reordered by dragging or with arrow buttons. Products are never deleted.
  • Prices now live in the database (`bhcc_price_book`), so plugin updates replace code and leave every price untouched. `bhcc-data.php` supplies only the starting price book, used once on first load and again on an explicit reset. Deleting the plugin deliberately keeps the price book and change log, since reinstalling is a common repair.
  • CSV import and export. Export includes hidden products and puts each price break in its column heading. Import shows every change, error, and warning before anything applies, and is refused if the price book was saved after the preview was made. Tolerates dollar signs, thousands separators, semicolon delimiters, byte-order marks, reordered columns, and files without a Key column (matched by name, in order, so two products with one name are not confused). Formula-looking text is neutralized on export and restored on import.
  • Change Log (`bhcc_price_book_history`): the last 50 saves, imports, restores, and resets, each with who, when, a plain-language list of changes, and a full copy of the price book. Any version can be restored; products added since are kept hidden; restores are themselves logged.
  • Guardrails. Saving is refused, with the form returned intact, for blank, zero, negative, or non-numeric prices, price breaks that do not increase, or every product hidden. A bulk rate higher than the smaller tier before it saves with a warning.
  • The calculator footer shows the prices-as-of date, stamped whenever prices actually change. Saving with no changes does not move it. Footer and yield text are now built from the data, so they cannot go stale.
  • Stable and Beta update channels. Beta reads `manifest-beta.json` and `manifest.json` and installs whichever is newer, so a test site never falls behind production.
  • Price fields renamed `retail`, `bulk1`, `bulk2`, `bulk3` (were `lb_retail`, `lb10`, `lb60`, `lb360`), since the breaks are no longer fixed at 10, 60, and 360.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1.
